title: Autonomous Geo-SEO Engine & Schema.org JSON-LD Career Landing System (Dynamic Regional Hubs, llms.txt Crawler Indexation & Rich Search Snippets)
spec:
# DIR-024: Autonomous Geo-SEO Engine & Schema.org JSON-LD Career Landing System

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives (Opportunity Fix)
Organic candidate and recruiter acquisition in India requires strong regional and programmatic SEO. While the platform backend has `geoSeoSettings` and `llmGeoSettings` in MariaDB, the frontend has not yet exposed dynamic Indian city/state career hubs or structured `llms.txt` endpoints for modern AI-driven search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot).

This directive mandates a 10/10 implementation of an **Autonomous Geo-SEO & AI Search Engine**, introducing regional career hubs for major Indian tech clusters, automated Schema.org JSON-LD structured data injection, standardized `/llms.txt` crawler indexation, and dedicated Playwright E2E verification.

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Dynamic Regional Career Hubs**:
   - Routes: `/jobs/in/:state` and `/jobs/city/:cityName` (e.g. `/jobs/city/bengaluru`, `/jobs/city/hyderabad`, `/jobs/city/pune`, `/jobs/city/delhi-ncr`).
   - Dynamically filter MariaDB jobs matching the city, render a localized Cuba M3 hero ("Explore Top Software & Tech Jobs in Bengaluru"), display current active vacancies, average salary ranges in INR (₹ LPA), and top hiring companies.

2. **Automated Schema.org JSON-LD Structured Data**:
   - `RouteSeo.jsx`: Programmatically inject W3C/Google compliant JSON-LD `<script type="application/ld+json">` schemas:
     - `JobPosting`: title, description, hiringOrganization, jobLocation, baseSalary (currency: INR), datePosted, validThrough, employmentType.
     - `Organization`: name, url, logo, contactPoint, sameAs (social links).
     - `BreadcrumbList`: itemListElement reflecting current portal path hierarchy.
     - `FAQPage`: mainEntity with question and acceptedAnswer.

3. **High-Fidelity `/llms.txt` & AI Crawler Optimization**:
   - Serve `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` from backend or public route based on `llmGeoSettings` in MariaDB.
   - Format: Concise Markdown index outlining IME365 capabilities (AI Resume Builder with 51 templates, Audio Interview Coach, ATS Keyword Matcher, Digital Portfolios, Job Board).

4. **Dedicated Playwright E2E Verification**:
   - Author `playwright.dir024.config.js` targeting `tests/e2e/dir024-geo-seo.spec.js`.
   - Validate JSON-LD script presence, regional route filtering, `/llms.txt` HTTP 200 response, and canonical meta tags against the live stack with zero mocks.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).
INV-2: Real MariaDB Job Data: Regional job counts and titles must be queried from authoritative MariaDB jobs table with zero synthetic mock jobs.
INV-3: Zero Insecure Script Injection: Schema JSON-LD must be serialized safely without allowing XSS injection via user-supplied job titles or descriptions.
INV-4: Mobile First Performance: Core Web Vitals (LCP < 2.0s, CLS < 0.05, FID < 50ms) maintained across all public SEO pages.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Server response time for /llms.txt < 50ms; bundle build < 4.0s.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Dynamic Indian Regional Job Hubs: In src/components/JobsLanding/, support dynamic regional routes (/jobs/in/:state or /jobs/city/:cityName) that render tailored search landing pages for top Indian tech hubs (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Chennai) with localized salary benchmarks and active vacancy counts.

AC-2: Automated Schema.org JSON-LD Structured Data: In RouteSeo.jsx, inject validated JSON-LD schemas for: (a) JobPosting schema on job detail pages, (b) Organization schema on homepage, (c) BreadcrumbList schema on category pages, (d) FAQPage schema on FAQs. Validate with 0 Google Search Console warnings.

AC-3: High-Fidelity llms.txt & Markdown Summary Endpoints: Implement /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt endpoints (governed by llmGeoSettings in MariaDB) that provide clean, structured markdown summaries of platform capabilities, job listings, and career guides for AI crawlers (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
AC-4: OpenGraph & Twitter Card Dynamic Previews: Generate dynamic SVG or optimized preview cards for public job postings and blog articles with company logo, job title, and salary tags.

AC-5: Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir024.config.js & tests/e2e/dir024-geo-seo.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server verifying JSON-LD injection, regional page rendering, /llms.txt content, and canonical link integrity.
AC-6: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

plan.summary: DIR-024 audit complete against the LIVE stack (vite dev :3000 = 200, backend :8080 = 200, MariaDB authoritative, HEAD e314f715, INV-1 frozen diff = 0 bytes). SEVEN PROVEN FINDINGS. F1 - /llms.txt IS LIVE-BROKEN (returns 503). Root cause is a status-mapping defect at backend/index.js:4011-4026: MariaDB public_config.llmGeo = enableLlmGeo true with llmsTxtContent EMPTY; normalizeLlmDiscoverySettings therefore throws LLMS_CONTENT_REQUIRED (status 400), and the catch clause maps ANY status===400 to 503 Service Unavailable. A not-published state is being reported as a service outage - misleading to AI crawlers and a false positive for the INV-5 <50ms probe. Reproduced deterministically. F2 - /llms-full.txt does not exist anywhere (0 files matched repo-wide). F3 - RouteSeo.jsx emits ZERO JSON-LD; the only ld+json emitters in the codebase are BlogPost.jsx and PublicPortfolio.jsx. No JobPosting, Organization, BreadcrumbList or FAQPage exists on any shared route. F4 - No regional routes exist; main.jsx mounts only /jobs, /jobs/portal, /jobs/portal/:jobId, /jobs/browse, /jobs/categories, /jobs/category/:catName. F5 - AC-1 DATA BLOCKER versus INV-2: the live jobs table has 25 rows, all status active, of which EXACTLY 4 are India rows and ALL 4 are Bengaluru (2 Hybrid + 2 On-site). Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR and Chennai each return ZERO rows. AC-1 mandates all six hubs with live vacancy counts and INR LPA benchmarks while INV-2 forbids synthetic jobs, so 5 of 6 required cities have no authoritative data. F6 - the companies table is EMPTY (0 rows) and /api/public/featured-companies returns an empty array, so top hiring companies cannot come from it; real company names exist only denormalised on jobs.company_name (Atlassian, Razorpay, Flipkart, Swiggy for Bengaluru). F7 - getJobs supports only publicOnly, status, employerId and limit; there is no city, location or aggregation filter, and the jobs table has NO city or state column (location is free-text VARCHAR(255) such as Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)), so regional filtering and salary statistics need a new read-only parameterised projection. ADDITIONAL GAP: geoSeo is live in MariaDB (enableGeoSeo true, targetRegion IN, targetCity Bengaluru, enableJobPostingSchema true, enableOrganizationSchema true) but is consumed ONLY by src/hooks/useMetaManager.js, never by RouteSeo, and has NO normalizer - backend/services/discoveryMetadata.js exports normalizeLlmDiscoverySettings only, while geoSeo merely passes the generic normalizeAdminSettingValue allow-list. The exact flags AC-2 depends on are therefore neither validated on write nor read on render.
steps: 1. Fix F1: split the status mapping inside the /llms.txt handler so a 400 LLMS_CONTENT_REQUIRED resolves to not-published 404, reserving 503 for genuine repository/MariaDB failure, and add a backend regression test proving not-published no longer masquerades as an outage

2. Add normalizeGeoSeoSettings to backend/services/discoveryMetadata.js with a strict field allow-list mirroring normalizeLlmDiscoverySettings, wire it into the POST /api/admin/settings category branch beside llmGeo, and cover it in backend/test/discovery-metadata.test.js

3. Add backend/database/migrations/020_geo_regional_projection.sql plus its down script, backfilling normalised city/state deterministically from the existing free-text location string with no invented values and no fabricated rows

4. Create backend/services/geoRegionalService.js holding the canonical Indian city and state alias table, a parameterised LIKE match against jobs.location, and a GROUP BY salary aggregation returning vacancy count, min, max, average and distinct companies - read-only, publicOnly, never fabricating a row

5. Expose GET /api/public/geo/regions and GET /api/public/geo/regions/:slug from the MariaDB repository, register both in publicApiPaths in backend/index.js, and add RBAC rows in tests/backend-rbac-expanded.test.cjs

6. Add /llms-full.txt beside /llms.txt governed by the same llmGeo settings with its own normalised content field, then extend public/.htaccess and the scripts/generate-api-inventory.mjs plus certify-all-286-endpoints-live.mjs allow-lists

7. Author the factual llms.txt and llms-full.txt Markdown respecting the UNSUPPORTED_PUBLIC_CLAIM guard - it rejects phrases like 51 resumes, any rating, any aggregate count and any outcome promise, so capability counts must be phrased in a non-matching form
8. Extract the FAQ dataset out of Homepagefaqs.jsx into a shared exported module consumed by both the component and the JSON-LD builder so visible content and FAQPage schema can never drift

9. Build src/components/JobsLanding/RegionalJobHub.jsx as the lazy route target, rendering the localized Cuba M3 hero, live vacancy count, INR LPA benchmark band, top hiring companies derived from jobs.company_name, and an explicit honest empty state whenever a region has zero authoritative rows

10. Mount /jobs/city/:cityName and /jobs/in/:state in src/main.jsx ahead of the existing jobs routes and add the corresponding public/sitemap.xml entries, which the existing sitemap no-private-route guard permits

11. Extend RouteSeo.jsx with one safe JSON-LD emitter covering Organization on the homepage, BreadcrumbList on category and regional routes, JobPosting on job detail and FAQPage on FAQ routes, serialised with a script-terminator-safe encoder so user-supplied job titles cannot break out (INV-3)

12. Add dynamic OpenGraph and Twitter card previews for job postings and blog articles, injecting og:image and twitter meta ONLY on indexable job and blog routes so the existing DIR-019 zero-og:image assertions for unavailable portfolios remain green

13. Author playwright.dir024.config.js and tests/e2e/dir024-geo-seo.spec.js against the live stack with zero /api mocks, mirroring the proven DIR-022 config, plus tests/dir024-geo-seo.test.mjs unit coverage

14. Gate on evidence: vite build under 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm run test and npm run test:security with zero regressions, /llms.txt under 50ms measured on the live backend, INV-1 diff 0 bytes, and a real-DOM Playwright crawl of every new route
15. ESCALATE the F5 decision to the Lead before AC-1 is implemented as literally written, since five of the six mandated cities have no authoritative job rows
